_doc: Programmes and platforms: one entry per document we try to fetch, with provenance. 'provenance' is 'officiel' (candidate/party site), 'copie-tierce' (a third-party mirror, used only when the official URL is gone) or 'vie-publique' (collected by speeches.py, not listed here). 'attribution' is 'personnelle' (the candidate's own programme) or 'parti' (party platform). Add entries only for URLs actually seen publicly; a failed fetch is recorded, not hidden. Run: collect.py programmes --people ids.
